known_before_run: STEP-01, LOWDIM-01/02A, GRID-01 and LOWDIM-03 results, the P22/SRCMAP records and exploratory model fits and volume figures were visible; this is not blind validation.
prohibitions: no Stage B, line search, curvature model, basis expansion or reinitialization
no automatic resubmission or repair after a terminal/integrity failure
a verdict is not a go-ahead: the next action needs its own preregistration

rules.incomplete: any integrity failure, one grid incomplete, a non-finite run: no analysis is written
rules.parent_gate: fresh parent CSVs must be byte-identical to the retained LOWDIM-03 s1.25 mm runs before any perturbation runs
rules.secants: centered [R(+s)-R(-s)]/(2s), s=1.25 mm, per grid and force
rules.verdict: FOUND only if both the main and the L1-robust cross-grid problems pass: t* above 1e-8 and predicted 1.25 mm downforce >= 3e-5 N on both grids; unresolved components are reported, never INCOMPLETE
